Nvidia shares were up 0.5% at $190.05 in premarket trading, while futures tied to the  index were down 0.2%.  President Donald Trump said last month he would allow shipments of the company’s H200 chip to China, provided that Nvidia gives the U.S. government a 25% cut of sales.
